Aix sponsa

Wood Duck is a medium-sized duck known for its striking and colorful plumage. For identification, habitat, and natural-history details, see the Aix sponsa species page.

The orange eye of the Wood Duck is a distinctive feature that helps in its identification. The vibrant plumage and intricate patterns on its body are also characteristic of this species, making it easily recognizable in its natural habitat.

The water splashing around the Wood Duck highlights its takeoff, capturing the dynamic movement and energy of the bird as it launches into the air.
